symmetryCheck: Aligned set (Ekal Abhiyan, Vivekananda Kendra, DRI, Akshaya Patra/ISKCON) vs neutral/critical set (Sulabh; the Right-to-Food SHG suppliers; and, from the sibling files, Oxfam/CARE/CPR): for ministry grants-in-aid the same fields are empty on both sides because no reachable page publishes recipients — the honest result is 'not testable here', not 'clean'. Where a recipient-level Union payment is documented it is the Gandhi Peace Prize purse: 3 of 5 laureates in the 2015–18 batch are Sangh/ISKCON-affiliated, chosen unanimously by a jury including the CJI and the Congress leader; Sulabh got the same ₹1 cr. The largest documented state flows to any association here go to Akshaya Patra (₹205 cr FY18, ₹72 cr from Karnataka), which is FCRA-registered and religiously run — and the same Karnataka government that fought it over onions renewed its MoU. On the delivery side the lens is symmetric across parties: SHG suppliers were displaced by big contractors under Maharashtra's BJP-led government (2016–17) and paid irregularly under MP's BJP government (2018–24), while the PUCL rule they were breaching dates from UPA-era litigation; the same SHG network is the intake layer for Shinde/BJP's Ladki Bahin and the payment layer for Nitish Kumar's MMRY. Nothing in this file distinguishes the aligned from the critical associations except the absence of data.
